name: Ring of Escape
body:
Price 11,200 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 7; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is made of shiny light metal wires, woven together in a braid. When activated the wires shift and move. Once per day when the wearer is subject to a spell or effect that allows for a Reflex save, they can activate the ring as an immediate action to teleport away as per the dimension door spell with a 40 foot range.This teleportation occurs before the effects that required the Reflex save, so the wearer of the ring is unaffected assuming their new location is outside the affected area.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,600 gp; Feats Forge Ring, dimension door
